copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发任务中引用外部MCP工具
copy.tagline_en: Load external MCP tools for reference at task start
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reference external MCP tools in your development tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用多种外部工具：管理记忆、查询文档、搜索代码、控制浏览器、索引代码库、操作 GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo 仓库、抓取网页、进行分步推理。
howto.when: 当需要处理复杂任务，如代码搜索、文档查询、版本控制操作或网页内容提取时，Claude 会自动调用这些工具。

say.text: 帮我搜索 GitHub 上关于 'react hooks' 的代码示例。
say.note: Claude 会使用代码搜索工具查找相关代码。

say.text: 查询 Python 官方文档中关于列表推导式的说明。
say.note: Claude 会先解析库 ID，然后查询文档。

say.text: 打开百度首页，截图给我看。
say.note: Claude 会使用浏览器工具打开并截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use various external tools: manage memory, query docs, search code, control browser, index codebase, operate GitHub/GitLab/Forgejo repos, crawl web pages, and perform step-by-step reasoning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when handling complex tasks such as code search, documentation queries, version control operations, or web content extraction.

say_en.text: Search GitHub for code examples about 'react hooks'.
say_en.note: Claude will use code search tool to find relevant code.

say_en.text: Query Python official docs about list comprehensions.
say_en.note: Claude will resolve library ID first, then query docs.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot for me.
say_en.note: Claude will use browser tool to open and screenshot.
